note: Shield sphere block rows (AUTO55, 2026-10-05): printed lines that were GM riders, now answered by combat/ext/shield_wielding.py, shield_mobility.py, shield_uncbroken.py and shield_incarnation.py.

TAL_SHIELD_GUARDED_STANCE.why: 'You may use Active Defense when you are not equipped with a Shield. Choose one weapon you are wielding. Treat that weapon as a Shield for talents that reference your Shield. The chosen weapon has a Shield Bonus of 0' (combat/ext/shield_wielding.py).

TAL_SHIELD_ORBITING_SHIELD_DISC.why: 'For the duration: count as wielding the Shield; retain its Shield Bonus; ... may use Shield talents normally' (combat/ext/shield_wielding.py).

TAL_SHIELD_SHIELD_SKATE.why: 'Until the end of the current turn: ... ignore nonmagical difficult terrain that your Shield can physically cross; do not benefit from the Shield's AC bonus during movement made through Shield Skate' (combat/ext/shield_mobility.py).

TAL_SHIELD_RIDING_THE_FALLING_STAR.why: 'you may descend vertical surfaces safely; you reduce falling damage by five times your Cultivation Level; if you fall at least 20 feet ... you may move up to your Speed along the ground immediately after landing' (combat/ext/shield_mobility.py).

TAL_SHIELD_UNBROKEN_RIM.why: 'When your Shield would break, be disarmed, become suppressed, or be destroyed ... expend Martial Focus. Choose one: the Shield remains intact and equipped; the Shield becomes cracked but functional until the end of your next turn; immediately catch and re-equip the Shield after it is disarmed' (combat/ext/shield_uncbroken.py).

TAL_SHIELD_SHIELD_SOUL_NEVER_FALLS.why: 'suppress the Shield's destruction until the end of your next turn; immediately establish one projected Shield Face without spending an Action' beside the 1-HP result the record already typed (combat/ext/shield_incarnation.py).

TAL_SHIELD_SOVEREIGN_SHIELD_SOUL_INCARNA.why: 'use Active Defense once per round without spending a Reaction or expending Martial Focus; gain one additional Reaction each round, usable only for Shield talents' (combat/ext/reaction_economy.py, the rows Adamant Guardian Incarnation and Sovereign of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves already use); 'gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet and Hover ... reduce damage from the triggering attack by your Proficiency Bonus ... regain Martial Focus whenever a hostile attack misses because of your Active Defense' (combat/ext/shield_incarnation.py); the wider Faces are combat/ext/shield_faces.py.
